title: Emily's Revival
description: Great textures, great game! Do you agree?
body:
**The goal of this pack is to improve the textures that need work, giving the game a much better feel!**

Many updates are planned, adding new content and improving the old — all to make the game better.



![New Spear](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e18e83e8b14927ad5e2b055b8448833fc5fc61fc.png)
Items will no longer share textures — from now on, every item is truly unique!



![New Tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d1dedd94be2ed2d9c600826aa3fce2958d322ce.png)
All tools and weapons in Emily's Revival have been completely retextured. Each item now has a distinct look, unlike the original repeating textures.



![New Ores](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3cb9c23c66a2ec5fc6620a65ea024d3f9f8e54cc.png)
New textures for items and blocks!

### My social media

Follow the creation process on my [Telegram channel!](https://t.me/star_im_emily)

I share frequent updates there. Your ideas and suggestions are always welcome to make the pack even better!

### Bedrock version available?

Yes, Bedrock Edition is supported!


Download the Bedrock version of the pack.

Rename the file from .zip to .mcpack.

Open the .mcpack file — it will automatically import into Minecraft Bedrock.


You can get the Minecraft Bedrock version on [Planet Minecraft!](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/emilystar/)
